description: A CMMS downtime log, one stop per row: when the machine stopped and restarted, the stop type and the reason, as entered (often by hand at an HMI terminal, after the fact). Each row is an intervention: Stop Type is its mode, verbatim, never ranked or read as a cause. Times are wall-clock text on the log's own clock; the export states no zone, so none is declared, and a time of day without a date is never completed (ADR 0016). Copy and edit the column names for your CMMS.
